title: What do you say on a first date?
old_caption: Wrong answers only: Aries keeps score, Capricorn unrolls a five-year plan ending in a bigger dog, and Gemini says everything at once for four hours. What's the worst first date opener you've heard?

title: Showing you care: 2006 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember burning a CD for your crush?
Twenty years later, Taurus still makes the playlist with the same title and a smudged heart. New format, same effort.

title: Love notes: 2006 vs 2026
old_caption:
Did you ever pass a "do u like me" note with checkboxes?
Now it's a voice note re-recorded four times. Any format, still brave.

title: Texting a crush: 2006 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember pressing 7 four times just to type one letter?
Texting got faster. The nerves before hitting send never did.

title: First kiss nerves: 2010 vs 2026
old_caption:
Did you ever practice for a first kiss on a pillow?
The nerves are the same, the move is braver now: just ask. Asking is romantic.

title: Going official: 2010 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember announcing a relationship in all caps for everyone?
In 2026 Leo tells two best friends over coffee. Big love can be quiet.

title: Long-distance: 2010 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember video calls that froze right in the middle of a laugh?
Capricorn and Virgo still freeze sometimes. The laugh never changed.

title: Us: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
What if you were in the same cafe as your person years before you met?
Aquarius finds Leo in the back of an old selfie. Almost, then us.

title: Baking together: 2020 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember baking "together" through a screen?
Now it's flour everywhere and one lumpy heart loaf. Still lumpy, still theirs.

title: Plans: 2020 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember pinning a whole wall map with someday plans?
They finally went everywhere, and the couch at home is still the favorite place.
